## If you are adding an event

- [ ] I followed the [Add an event guide](https://github.com/renisha18/sheBuildsTN/blob/main/docs/add-event.md)

- [ ] One new file in `src/data/events/`, named `YYYY-MM-DD-short-name.json`
- [ ] The event is in Tamil Nadu, and my `chapter` is filled in
- [ ] It has at least one tag, and **every tag is supported by the post** (when unsure, I left it off)
- [ ] `collaborated` is only used with `partners` listed (co-organisers, not sponsors)
- [ ] A past event has `postUrl`; an upcoming event has `registerUrl` if registration is open
- [ ] I didn't guess any date or number (unknown = `null`)
- [ ] No phone numbers or emails, and I have the right to share any image
